svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 12/12 Redwood Fog (Common)
svg.desc: Fog climbs the hill from the bay and settles in the trees. Everything goes quiet and damp. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
